messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

建議主軸：current vault evidence supports one clear automotive signal-generator/analyzer-type opportunity—CMX500-based hybrid / NG eCall testing; standalone SMW200A / FSW / FSWX automotive opportunities are not directly supported by the supplied Raw passages, which only identify the instrument categories/products without an automotive link [65][66][67][68].
### Recommended first
| Rank by current evidence strength | Opportunity | Evidence-supported reason |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Hybrid / Next Generation eCall validation using R&S CMX500 RF generator/analyzer and spectrum-analysis capabilities | Rohde & Schwarz says its hybrid eCall and NG eCall test solution is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester and passed cetecom advanced certification testing [15][20]. The same source says manufacturers need to validate call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning, and intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE and circuit-switched fallback scenarios [15]. CMX500 has RF generator routing for receiver tests, RF analyzer routing for transmitter tests, spectrum-analysis options, ARB generation, FFT spectrum analyzer functions, and IF/RF units providing vector signal analysis plus ARB-based generator functionality [24][25][26][28][29][31]. |
| Not rankable as automotive | ADC / DAC frontend performance using signal generators and spectrum analyzers | Raw evidence says the ADC / DAC frontend performance material involves “Spectrum Analyzers” and “Signal Generators” [65], and names the R&S SMW200A vector signal generator as test equipment while pointing to R&S signal and spectrum analyzers [66]. Raw evidence also names R&S FSW and FSWX signal and spectrum analyzers [67][68]. No supplied passage states this ADC / DAC frontend opportunity is automotive. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Passage-stated need | Confirmed option / specification | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Hybrid / NG eCall test solution; validate emergency-call behavior under network scenarios | RF generators for receiver testing, RF analyzers for transmitter testing, spectrum-analysis option, ARB and FFT spectrum analyzer capabilities, vector signal analysis and ARB-based generator IF/RF units | [15][24][25][26][28][29][31][63] | It is a radio communication tester, not a standalone SMW/FSW-class signal generator or spectrum analyzer [30]. |
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS testing configuration | Knowledge base only names SMBV100B as the vector signal generator in the eCall GNSS Testing configuration | [64] | Supplied Raw passages do not provide SMBV100B automotive configuration detail, order numbers, or option dependencies. |
| R&S SMW200A | Raw app-note context names SMW200A as a vector signal generator | SMW200A is identified as a vector signal generator in Raw evidence [66]; Wiki confirms SMW200A is a vector signal generator up to 67 GHz on RF path A [40] | [40][66] | No supplied Raw passage ties SMW200A to automotive. |
| R&S FSW / FSWX | Raw passages identify signal and spectrum analyzer products | Raw names “Rohde & Schwarz FSW Signal and Spectrum Analyzer” and “Rohde & Schwarz FSWX Signal and Spectrum Analyzer” | [67][68] | No supplied Raw passage ties FSW or FSWX to an automotive application; the AREG800A radar source only says a spectrum analyzer is used for IF-domain Doppler offset measurement, not that FSW/FSWX is required [4]. |
| R&S AREG800A | Automotive radar echo generation | Dynamic artificial object generation; Doppler offset accuracy measured using a spectrum analyzer | [2][4] | AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer per the current knowledge base [9]. |
### Scenario cut-in suggestions
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Evidence | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hybrid / NG eCall compliance and certification preparation | Lead with R&S CMX500 plus eCall software context CMX-KA09x / CMX-KA098 / CMX-KA099 where applicable | CMX500-based solution passed cetecom advanced certification testing; CMX-KA09x supports EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance; CMX-KA099 completed PSAP scenarios for EN 18052:2025; CMX-KA098 completed PSAP scenarios for EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 [15][63] | Source does not provide certificate number, complete test-case IDs, software versions, order numbers, or pass/fail details [16]. |
| NG eCall EN 17240:2024 implementation validation | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 | Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm Technologies used R&S CMX500 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality against EN 17240:2024; CMX500 with CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [22][58][60] | Source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, test setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, GNSS setup, or pass/fail details [57]. |
| eCall GNSS positioning validation | R&S SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS Testing configuration | CMX configuration guide knowledge lists R&S SMBV100B in the eCall GNSS Testing configuration, and hybrid eCall validation includes maintaining GNSS positioning [61][64] | Supplied passages do not specify SMBV100B options, GNSS scenario files, or required software. |
| Automotive radar echo / Doppler validation workflow | R&S AREG800A plus a spectrum analyzer measurement step | AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator; Doppler frequency offset accuracy is measured using a spectrum analyzer in the IF domain [2][4] | Supplied passages do not identify FSW, FSWX, or another R&S analyzer as the required analyzer for this AREG800A measurement. |
### Limitations
No supplied Raw passage directly states an automotive application for SMW200A, FSW, or FSWX; Raw only identifies signal-generator / signal-and-spectrum-analyzer categories and product names [65][66][67][68].
- 【推論】The best-supported sell-first opportunity is CMX500-based hybrid / NG eCall because the passages combine automotive regulation/compliance context, third-party certification context, and explicit RF generator/analyzer/spectrum-analysis capabilities in one R&S platform [15][24][25][26][58][63].

| 1 | Hybrid / Next Generation eCall validation using R&S CMX500 RF generator/analyzer and spectrum-analysis capabilities | Rohde & Schwarz says its hybrid eCall and NG eCall test solution is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester and passed cetecom advanced certification testing [15][20]. The same source says manufacturers need to validate call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning, and intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE and circuit-switched fallback scenarios [15]. Raw evidence also names R&S FSW and FSWX signal and spectrum analyzers [67][68]. No supplied passage states this ADC / DAC frontend opportunity is automotive. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Passage-stated need | Confirmed option / specification | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Hybrid / NG eCall test solution; validate emergency-call behavior under network scenarios | RF generators for receiver testing, RF analyzers for transmitter testing, spectrum-analysis option, ARB and FFT spectrum analyzer capabilities, vector signal analysis and ARB-based generator IF/RF units | [15][24][25][26][28][29][31][63] | It is a radio communication tester, not a standalone SMW/FSW-class signal generator or spectrum analyzer [30]. |

| Scenario | Recommended combination | Evidence | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|

No supplied Raw passage directly states an automotive application for SMW200A, FSW, or FSWX; Raw only identifies signal-generator / signal-and-spectrum-analyzer categories and product names [65][66][67][68].

R&S AREG800A
[[R&S AREG800A]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Automotive Radar Echo Generator，用於 dynamic artificial object generation；本頁規格依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`。

R&S AREG800A › 文件與適用條件
- 來源文件：[[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]。
- 文件編號：`PD 3609.8015.22`。
- 文件版本：`Version 09.00`。
- 文件日期：`September 2025（LA）`。
- 文件名稱：`AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`。
- Copyright：`© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。
- 資料註記：無 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力；資料 `subject to change`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 於環境溫度儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- `Specifications with limits`：以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示保證產品性能。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：表示保證產品性能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依 GUM 計算。

R&S AREG800A › Radial velocity 與 Doppler
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- 每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift：`yes`。
- Velocity setting range with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`±500 km/h`。
- Velocity step size：
  - [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`0.001 km/h`。
  - [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] with [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]]：`0.05 km/h`。
- Doppler frequency offset accuracy：在 IF domain 以 spectrum analyzer 量測 base unit IF input 與 IF output signal 的 frequency offset，不含 frontend，`< 1 Hz`。
- Velocity accuracy：Doppler shift velocity error 由公式 `v_error = 3.6 × (f_error/f_center) × ½ × 299 700 000 m/s` 決定；`f_center` 為 `78 GHz` 或 `79 GHz`，適用於 [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]；velocity accuracy `< 0.05 km/h`。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。

- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。

- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。

- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。

- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
